_comment: Negative cases for the end-to-end detection eval: code surfaces that are NOT vulnerable. Ground truth: no candidate finding should be surfaced (similarity >= threshold) — anything surfaced is a false positive. These are standard, well-guarded implementations in domains far from the corpus findings (plus one guarded oracle, the 'fixed' version of a corpus finding, to test whether the FP corpus + gate saves the reviewer).
